post.title: Brand Asset Kit
post.hook: Four files, no code: the visuals behind a whole set of experiments.
post.summary: A small folder of image assets: three JPGs and one SVG, including a 1200x1200 social card and a 1400x1400 Mobius render. There is no code or history, only the visuals.
post.writeup:
## What it is
A small asset folder holding four files: three JPGs and one SVG, 286,647 bytes in total. It is not a git repo and has no code, README or notes.

## Why it exists
The files look like supporting visuals for other projects: a 1200x1200 image originally named og.jpg, which fits a social or Open Graph card, and a 1400x1400 image originally named mobius.jpg.

## What is in it
- og.jpg, 1200x1200
- mobius.jpg, 1400x1400
- one more JPG and one SVG, not shown in the media list

## Findings
There is little to measure here. The material gives sizes and formats, not process or results. Both visible images are square, which suggests they were made to be reused across feeds and cards.

## Open questions
Which projects use these assets, and how the Mobius image was generated, are not recorded anywhere in the folder.
